measurements.name: critical wavelength lambda_c
measurements.reference_source: slot assignment: 253 µm primordium detail scale at 37.0 Ma
measurements.note: identity check: Du and Dv were solved so lambda_c equals this assignment

measurements.name: turing growth rate sigma_max
measurements.method: max real eigenvalue of J - k^2 D over k in (0, 0.12]

measurements.name: equal-diffusion control sigma_max
measurements.note: ablation: equal diffusion must sit below the unequal-diffusion growth rate

measurements.name: nonlinear activator field std
measurements.method: std of u after 6000 explicit-Euler steps on 80²
measurements.reference_source: homogeneous steady state has spatial std 0

measurements.name: chronoseries modes predecessor_protocetid_bud
measurements.method: domain length / 253 µm at fixed chemistry
measurements.reference_source: comparison partner on the limb-to-flipper series
measurements.note: age 47.0 Ma; domain 2024.0 µm; protocetid functional hindlimb bud

measurements.name: chronoseries modes dorudon_atrox
measurements.method: domain length / 253 µm at fixed chemistry
measurements.reference_source: comparison partner on the limb-to-flipper series
measurements.note: age 37.0 Ma; domain 759.0 µm; Dorudon atrox vestigial hindlimb

measurements.name: chronoseries modes successor_crown_cetacean
measurements.method: domain length / 253 µm at fixed chemistry
measurements.reference_source: comparison partner on the limb-to-flipper series
measurements.note: age 0.0 Ma; domain 0.0 µm; crown cetacean external hindlimb

measurements.name: specimen radial-profile Pearson r
measurements.method: azimuthal mean vs degree-5 vignette + J0(k)+J0(2k)+J0(3k), k fixed at 253 µm
measurements.reference_source: same plate profile fit by the vignette polynomial with the Bessel terms removed

measurements.name: specimen plate radial RMSE
measurements.method: root mean square residual of the 253 µm radial law
measurements.reference_source: a 0.1 luminance RMSE would be a poor fit on a unit-interval profile
measurements.note: value is the achieved RMSE; reference is a failure threshold, not the value

measurements.name: specimen image foreground fraction
measurements.method: border-median contrast mask at the 45th percentile, threshold at least 0.06
measurements.reference_source: a balanced mask would cover half the plate; the measured mask does not

measurements.name: specimen secondary-ring radius
measurements.method: argmax of azimuthal luminance for bins 15..59, times measured µm/px
measurements.reference_source: model critical wavelength 253 µm (the law, not the plate's secondary peak)
measurements.note: the plate's 100 µm bar makes this peak a different length from λ_c; both numbers are kept
